items.title: Piece A - opt-in WCSAxes in the profile viewer (glue-core)
items.where: glue:profile-wcs commits f767d320 + c3bcd75b; glue/viewers/profile/viewer.py (`MatplotlibProfileMixin._set_wcs`, `update_x_ticklabel`/`update_y_ticklabel` overrides, `apply_roi` pixel branch, `_script_header`/`_script_footer`), glue/viewers/profile/state.py (`wcsaxes` class flag, `wcsaxes_active` property, `_wcsaxes_with_unit`, `wcsaxes_slice` property, `x_limits_pixel` DDCProperty, `_reset_x_limits` pixel branch, unit-change reset in `_convert_units_x_limits`)
items.evidence: Checkbox audit against diff: (1) _set_wcs pattern: `axes.frame_class = RectangularFrame1D` + `axes.reset_wcs(slices=..., wcs=...)`, `reference_data is None or x_att_pixel is None` guard, fallback `get_identity_wcs(1)` imported from glue.viewers.image.viewer - DONE. (2) wcsaxes_slice reads per-axis index from `self.slices` (no hardcoded 0), reversed to WCS order, no state mutation - DONE (implemented as a read-only property rather than the 'plain method' the TODO asked for; harmless). (3) update_x_ticklabel override using `self.axes.coords[axis].set_ticklabel(size=...)` with axis = ndim - x_att_pixel.axis - 1 - DONE. (4) Units reconciliation: main's `x_att -> _update_axes` callback kept (viewer.py setup_callbacks); axis label stays owned by _update_axes; BUT apply_roi now builds the subset on `x_att_pixel` when wcsaxes_active (the TODO listed the x_att->x_att_pixel swap as 'explicitly dead') - a deliberate deviation, justified in commit f767d320 (profile is plotted in pixel coords in this mode, same model as the image viewer). (5) Tests: test_wcsaxes_profile, test_wcsaxes_identity_fallback, test_wcsaxes_slices, test_wcsaxes_limits_mode_mismatch (test_viewer.py), TestExportPythonWCSAxes (re-runs the whole export suite on a WCSAxes viewer) - DONE; units tests unchanged and green. DESIGN RULE PICKED: exactly the TODO's proposal - `wcsaxes_active = viewer built with wcs=True AND reference coords are real (not None/LegacyCoordinates) AND x_att is a world component AND (x_display_unit or '') == component's native unit`; otherwise identity WCS + the untouched plain-numeric/x_display_unit path. In WCSAxes mode the profile, x limits and ROI are in pixel coordinates and WCSAxes formats world tick labels. Crossing the unit boundary resets x limits instead of converting. c3bcd75b adds `x_limits_pixel` so sessions saved in one mode restore sanely in the other. E2E (real IRIS raster via glue_solar loader, Qt viewer offscreen): wcsaxes True/active True, axes.wcs is d.coords, RectangularFrame1D, xlim (-0.5,16.5), ROI subset att = 'Pixel Axis 2 [x]', x_display_unit='nm' -> active False and x in nm (133.275..133.317), identity WCS restored. SJI: active for Time/Latitude/Longitude x_att, arcsec labels formatted as e.g. '−402"'. Tests: 57 passed, 1 skipped on the fork worktree.
items.blockers: Depends on Piece C (reads `slices`, `_set_default_slices`), so it must be a second PR stacked on C - verified: cherry-picking f767d320+c3bcd75b onto main+C gives one trivial conflict in python_export.py, then 57 passed. IRIS-specific caveat found by e2e: glue-solar's `_GlueWCS.world_axis_units` leaves wavelength in 'm', so WCSAxes tick labels on the IRIS wavelength axis read like '0.00000013328'; selecting Angstrom as x_display_unit is a unit override and switches WCSAxes off. That is a glue-solar loader issue (map em.wl to Angstrom the way helioprojective is mapped to arcsec in glue_solar/sources/loaders/iris.py:46-50), not a branch defect.
items.recommendation: Open as the second glue-core PR after C, with the design rule and the pixel-coordinate ROI model stated in the description (a reviewer will ask). Fix `_GlueWCS.world_axis_units` for wavelength in glue-solar before recommending WCSAxes mode to IRIS users.

items.title: What commit 98d7bb7c 'Translate slice views across linked datasets' does, and its relation to Phase 3.2
items.where: glue:profile-wcs 98d7bb7c; glue/viewers/profile/state.py `ProfileLayerState.slice_view(data, pix_cid)`; python_export.py; test_state.py::test_slice_function_linked / test_slice_function_out_of_bounds
items.evidence: Diff and commit message read. It is PROFILE-VIEWER-INTERNAL: `ProfileViewerState.slices` is defined in the reference data's pixel frame; for a layer whose dataset is NOT the reference data, slice_view evaluates `ref[data.pixel_component_ids[axis], point]` (i.e. walks the pixel/coordinate links) to find that dataset's own pixel index on each non-profile axis, rounds it, bounds-checks it, and raises IncompatibleDataException (layer disabled) for unlinked or out-of-range axes. Test: d1 (3,4,2) and d2 (4,3,2) with axes 0/1 swapped via LinkSame; slices=(0,2,1) on d1 yields d1['x'][:,2,1] and d2['y'][2,:,1]. Second half fixes the exported script fetching x values from the Subset (mask-shortened) instead of the parent Data. Nothing in it touches other viewers, ImageViewerState.slices, or any hub message - one viewer's slider position never moves another viewer's.
items.recommendation: Do not count this toward Phase 3.2. It is the per-layer correctness fix that lets two linked rasters share one profile viewer's slice point; the plan's 'synchronized slicing' (image viewer raster slider <-> SJI frame, time-nearest join) is a separate, unstarted glue-core/glue-qt feature.
items.doc_corrections: IRIS_GLUE_GAP_PLAN.md 'Coordinated raster browser ... synchronized slicing upstream' (line 39) and Phase 3.2 (line 148-153) could be misread as advanced by this branch; add one sentence that profile-wcs only translates slices between layers inside one profile viewer.

audit.notes: Summary: the profile-wcs work in PROFILE_WCS_RESTART_TODO.md is fully implemented on the two fork branches (glue:profile-wcs 4 commits, glue-qt:profile-wcs 1 commit), every Piece A/B/C checkbox is satisfied by code + tests, all suites green (57 / 81 / 68+14 skipped), and the glue-qt gating on glue-core capabilities works. The design rule chosen is the TODO's own proposal: WCSAxes formatting only when world coords are shown in their native unit (x_display_unit unset or equal to the component unit) on real coords, else the plain-axes/unit path; in WCSAxes mode the profile, limits and ROI are in pixel coordinates (image-viewer model), which reinstates the apply_roi x_att_pixel swap the TODO had marked dead. Commit 98d7bb7c is profile-viewer-internal (translates the reference slice point into other layers' pixel frames through links); it is not cross-viewer slice sync and does not advance Phase 3.2. Not PR-ready as-is: split into C then A (one trivial python_export.py conflict, verified), drop glue_qt/_version.py from the glue-qt commit, run pre-commit, write the design rule into the PR text; close #2248 and delete origin/1dprofile_wcs. Two IRIS-specific follow-ups for glue-solar rather than the branches: `_GlueWCS.world_axis_units` should present wavelength in Angstrom (currently 'm', giving unreadable WCSAxes tick labels), and viewer presets should set x_att=Wavelength and function='slice' (the profile viewer defaults to Helioprojective Longitude). Side observation outside my area: with irispy 0.8.1 the SJI dataset's inner WCS is an astropy `WCS`, not gWCS, contrary to the gap plan's Phase 3.1 wording. Also: irispy 0.8.1 read_files fails on the 2021 raster test file with spectral_windows=['Mg II k 2796'] ('Expected 187 NUV source filename rows, found 1872'); glue-solar tests only use the 2014 raster. Scratch worktrees and clone removed; user repos untouched.

verdicts.evidence: Diff read (git diff main...profile-wcs): FUNCTIONS gains 'slice'; `slices = DDCProperty`; `_set_default_slices` wired in `_reference_data_changed`; `update_profile` uses `data.get_data(attribute, view=view)` + `get_mask`, then `converter.to_unit` on y. Re-ran: PYTHONPATH=<glue-wt> pytest glue/viewers/profile -> 57 passed, 1 skipped (73s). Scratch clone: main + cherry-pick 175e7129 98d7bb7c -> 1 conflict in python_export.py (profile_x_values line), resolved to `x_att = state.x_att` + `base_data[...]` -> 36 passed, 1 skipped; no 'wcsaxes' refs left in the C-only tree. E2E (fork glue+glue-qt, IRIS 2014 C II raster (8,109,17)): function='slice', slices=(2,100,0) -> allclose to d[attr,(2,100,:)] True, x = pixel index. Out-of-range reference slices reproduced: slices=(7,200,0) -> IndexError 'index 200 is out of bounds for axis 1 with size 109' at state.py:582 (`data.get_data(..., view=view)`); SJI (3,50,60) -> same. Nuance: in the live viewer this is not a crash - layer_artist._calculate_profile_error only calls disable() for IncompatibleAttribute/IncompatibleDataException, so an IndexError just hides the artist silently (state.enabled stays True). Extra blocker the auditor missed: ruff 0.15.20 (the repo's pinned pre-commit version) with the repo config flags 3 new RUF059 errors, 2 of them from 98d7bb7c: tests/test_state.py:229 and :257 (`x, y = layer.profile`, x unused); main is clean on the same files. The hook runs `--fix` but RUF059 fixes are unsafe, so CI codestyle would fail.

Diff confirms every claim: `_set_wcs` with `reference_data is None or x_att_pixel is None` guard, RectangularFrame1D, `get_identity_wcs(1)` imported from glue.viewers.image.viewer; `wcsaxes_slice` property reads `self.slices[i]` (no hardcoded 0), reversed; `update_x_ticklabel` uses `coords[ndim - x_att_pixel.axis - 1].set_ticklabel`; `_wcsaxes_with_unit` = real coords (not None/LegacyCoordinates) AND x_att not pixel AND `(unit or '') == component.units` - exactly the TODO's proposed rule; apply_roi uses x_att_pixel only when wcsaxes_active. Tests test_wcsaxes_profile/_identity_fallback/_slices/_limits_mode_mismatch use `SimpleProfileViewer(app.session, wcs=True)`. E2E reproduced: default x_att = Helioprojective Longitude (world_component_ids[0]), wcsaxes True/active True, axes.wcs is d.coords, RectangularFrame1D, wcsaxes_slice (0,0,'x'); x_att=Wavelength -> xlim (-0.5,16.5), x_limits_pixel True, `coords[axis].format_coord(1.3328e-7)` = '0.00000013328' (glue-solar _GlueWCS.world_axis_units gives 'm' for em.wl, only helioprojective is remapped to arcsec at loaders/iris.py:46-50); x_display_unit='nm' -> active False, x 133.275..133.317, axes.wcs is coords False; back to 'm' -> active True; ROI -> subset att 'Pixel Axis 2 [x]'. Note x_display_unit cannot be set to '' (SelectionCallbackProperty choices), native = 'm'. Split verified: on the C-only clone, cherry-pick f767d320 -> 1 conflict (same python_export.py lines), c3bcd75b clean; 57 passed, 1 skipped; `git diff origin/profile-wcs` EMPTY (byte-identical to the branch tip, not 'one line'). Lint: tests/test_viewer.py:336 RUF059 (`y` unused) is new from the A commits. Label reset in `_set_wcs` (x_axislabel/y_axislabel = '') mirrors image viewer.py:120-121, so not a defect.

Diff confirms: MultiSliceWidgetHelper guards y_att/z_att via hasattr loop, `_plot_atts` prefers x_att_pixel, clears sliders when data/atts None, skips sync while len(slices) != ndim; data_viewer.py passes `wcs=hasattr(ProfileViewerState, 'wcsaxes')` (glue-qt MatplotlibDataViewer.__init__ accepts wcs=); options_widget creates helper only `if hasattr(viewer_state, 'slices')` and toggles widget_slices on function=='slice'; profile_tools.py applies UnitConverter (main's `data[x_att, axis_view]` ignores x_display_unit - real bug). Re-ran: both forks -> 81 passed, 1 skipped (unconditional skip test_data_viewer.py:60); glue-qt worktree + installed glue-core 1.27.0 (glue.__file__ = .venv site-packages) -> 68 passed, 14 skipped, 13 with 'installed glue-core has no WCSAxes profile support'/'no slice collapse function', 0 errors; glue_qt/viewers/image with both forks -> 69 passed, 2 skipped, 1 xfailed. `git ls-tree profile-wcs -- glue_qt/_version.py` = committed blob; `.gitignore:47 glue_qt/_version.py` ignores it. ruff 0.15.20 with repo config on the branch's .py files: 'All checks passed'. Commit diff: adds `ProfileLayerState.slice_view(data, pix_cid)` - for `data is ref` uses viewer_state.slices directly; otherwise evaluates `ref[data.pixel_component_ids[axis], point]` (link walk), rounds, bounds-checks, raises IncompatibleDataException on IncompatibleAttribute/out-of-range. Full diffs of glue:profile-wcs (7 files) and glue-qt:profile-wcs (9 files) contain no cross-viewer slice linking; MultiSliceWidgetHelper is per-options-widget with one viewer_state and no hub subscription.
